baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled huwa a'lam brackets the one who strayed from His way and the guided, while rabbuka names the knower as owner and governor of that way.
baseline_models.mechanism: Authoritative knowledge discloses and separates two opposed relations to one possessed route: departure from its aim and reception of gentle direction along it. The repeated formula gives both sides equal epistemic coverage without making the trajectories morally equal.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority make the way a governed course whose travelers are authoritatively distinguished.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic act repeated over both trajectories.
Deviation from aim and right course gives the first trajectory its directional failure.
An extended traversable road supplies the shared spatial mechanism rather than a merely abstract polarity.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the opposed trajectory of received orientation.

changed_reading.before: A general assurance that God knows who is right and who is wrong.
changed_reading.after: A formally balanced act of sovereign discrimination in which every movement relative to one governed way is fully disclosed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Rabbuka precedes two temporal shapes: man dalla presents a departure event, whereas al-muhtadin presents an ongoing or settled guided bearing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord is also the one who tends, repairs, and completes stage by stage. On that branch, the verse can classify processes under care: a person becomes lost from the course, while guided people sustain an aim and manner. Knowledge follows the whole development rather than freezing persons into unexplained labels.

activation_trace.role: Stage-by-stage nurture and repair make the knower also the caretaker of developing trajectories.
A thing lost from its owner turns deviation into a condition that can be tracked rather than an essence.
Direction, aim, manner, and conduct give guidance the shape of a sustained course.
Calm, composed bearing makes the guided participle describe a maintained disposition as well as a correct destination.

changed_reading.before: The verse names two permanent populations, the lost and the guided.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes two differently shaped trajectories known through their development: a departure can occur, and orientation can become a sustained bearing under care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of a'lam stand beside an explicit way, a loss from it, and a guided plurality.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge and visible marking coexist in the focus inventory. A road is followed through distinguishing marks and leading elements, while straying can also disappear from view. The Lord's knowledge therefore encompasses both the traces by which orientation becomes legible and the hiddenness by which deviation evades ordinary observers.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that also guides converts knowledge into the legibility of orientation.
Disappearance and absorption supply the countercondition in which deviation is hidden from ordinary sight.
The traversable route is the field on which marks, disappearance, and direction become consequential.
A guide or leading front supplies a visible orientation that others can follow.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns inaccessible inner states known only to God.
changed_reading.after: The verse also concerns the production, loss, and reading of waymarks: orientation leaves traces, disappearance hides them, and divine knowledge exceeds both conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context surrounds the focus with rival regimes of legibility: a writing reed and ordered lines, their dismissal as false stories, visible signs, and finally a promised bodily mark. This activates the mark branch of knowledge so that 68:7 becomes an adjudication of which inscription actually discloses a trajectory.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing and guiding mark makes epistemic discrimination materially legible.
The pared writing reed supplies the first instrument by which a durable line of testimony is made.
Ordered written rows supply inscription as an evidentiary form.
False tales supply the counter-inscription by which genuine signs are rhetorically misclassified.
A manifest sign supplies a visible datum that can be read truthfully or dismissed.
The nose or snout supplies the exposed bodily site on which the promised distinction is externalized.

structural_cues: 68:1, 68:15, and 68:16 move from writing, to dismissal as stories, to a future bodily inscription.
The marking root و س م at 68:16 has no branch inventory and is used only as this structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, ordered lines, false stories, a manifest sign, a bodily site, and an uncitable marking construction; I infer that outward inscription manifests the discrimination already asserted in 68:7. The live alternative is that the mark is only punitive and not evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge is asserted apart from the surah's acts of writing and labeling.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge arbitrates among competing inscriptions: truthful record, dismissive counter-story, and conduct made visibly distinguishable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A public diagnosis covers reason, future mutual sight delays human resolution, and an assay reveals what something is. The focus verse intervenes before that delayed visibility: the Lord already distinguishes the actual trajectory beneath a socially imposed label.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure to the knower supplies the prior judgment that contested observers lack.
The image of reason being covered supplies the opponents' diagnosis and its obscuring mechanism.
Future mutual eyesight makes human recognition a later event rather than the ground of the Lord's knowledge.
Testing metal or a person supplies an assay that separates actual constitution from accusation.

structural_cues: The sequence accusation, future seeing, disputed afflicted party, then doubled divine knowing makes 68:7 the epistemic hinge of 68:2-7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covered reason, deferred sight, and assay; I infer that 68:7 announces the verdict's epistemic basis before public disclosure. The live alternative is that maftun names an afflicted party without invoking an assay process.

changed_reading.before: The verse reassures the addressee by sorting believers from unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: The verse overturns a contested diagnosis: public labels can cover reality, whereas the Lord's discrimination precedes and governs eventual seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deviation is assembled socially. Obedience yields to soft mutual accommodation; gossip literally walks between people; transgression crosses a boundary. The Lord's way is therefore not only a proposition but a behavioral route produced by compliance, circulation, and repeated boundary crossing.

activation_trace.role: The extended route gives the social actions a common traversed course.
Departure from aim names the cumulative directional result of those social acts.
Submission and obedience supply the first transfer of agency into another group's course.
Soft accommodation and mutual placation supply the social lubricant by which resistance is reduced.
Gossip carried by walking turns corrupt speech into a route that travels through a community.
Crossing a limit supplies the boundary event by which the walked course becomes transgression.

structural_cues: The prohibitions in 68:8 and 68:10 interrupt a chain from compliance to accommodation, circulating speech, withheld good, and transgression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obedience, placation, walking gossip, and limit crossing; I infer a causal social route in which each act makes the next easier. The live alternative is a list of traits without a single developmental chain.

changed_reading.before: Straying is an individual's mistaken belief about a religious path.
changed_reading.after: Straying can be a socially walked trajectory whose direction is made by whom one obeys, accommodates, repeats, and follows across limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners conceal speech and proceed with a withholding intention, then sight produces the cry that they are lost, followed by the correction that they are deprived. A hidden moral itinerary becomes a spatial misrecognition before becoming self-recognition. The Lord's prior knowing in 68:7 thus includes the intention that makes travelers unable to recognize their own destination.

activation_trace.role: Failure to locate a known thing supplies the literal first layer of the owners' later declaration.
Prior disclosure to the Lord contrasts with the owners' delayed discovery of their own course.
A test that makes condition appear supplies the event by which concealed orientation becomes observable.
Lowered secret speech supplies the hidden planning that ordinary observers cannot hear.
Determined intention supplies the inward vector already directing the morning journey.
Withholding and contraction specify what that determined vector is designed to accomplish.
Eyesight and insight supply the shock at which planned confidence meets an unreadable result.
Loss of a fixed place voices their first spatial explanation for the ruined destination.
Missing the desired good revises the spatial diagnosis into recognition of deprivation.

structural_cues: The sequence 68:23-27 moves from secret intention, to confident travel, to seeing, to 'we are lost,' and then to 'rather, we are deprived.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, secrecy, restrictive intention, sight, lostness, and deprivation; I infer that the prior intention causes an epistemic inability to recognize the destination morally. The literal alternative that they first think they reached the wrong place remains active.

changed_reading.before: The Lord knows who has selected the wrong route.
changed_reading.after: The Lord knows a hidden intention as a trajectory before its travelers can read it; moral deviation may first appear to them as mere spatial confusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A just middle voice interrupts the owners, they clear their Lord of blame, face one another, confess boundary excess, hope for replacement, and redirect desire toward their Lord. This sequence keeps deviation and guidance from becoming sealed identities: recognition can bend a completed straying event into a new orientation.

activation_trace.role: Direction, intention, and conduct make guidance available as a reoriented course after recognition.
Justice and excellence located in the middle supply an internal corrective voice within the deviating group.
Exonerating and declaring transcendence redirect blame away from the Lord and back toward the actors.
Turning face-to-face supplies the first visible pivot from a unified secret plan to mutual accountability.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies their explicit retrospective diagnosis of the route.
Nurture and repair make their doubled return to 'our Lord' a request for developmental restoration.
One thing standing in place of another supplies hoped-for replacement after acknowledged loss.
Desire turning toward or away supplies the clearest directional reversal of their inward aim.

structural_cues: The grammar moves from 'we were wrongdoers' and 'we were transgressors' to present desire directed toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an internal corrective, confession, facing, replacement, and redirected desire; I infer a recoverable trajectory that can approach guidance after straying. The live alternative is that remorse is shown without the owners being certified as guided.

changed_reading.before: Those who strayed and the guided are mutually exclusive, permanent identity groups.
changed_reading.after: The Lord can know both moments within one history: completed deviation can be recognized, confessed, and bent toward renewed orientation without erasing what occurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later questions refuse to make the surrendered whole equivalent to the culpable cutter, challenge human judgment, demand its book, and ask for a guarantor behind unsupported claims. The doubled knowledge in 68:7 becomes the warrant for non-equivalence and the standard against which rival verdicts must produce evidence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the Lord supplies the complete epistemic warrant for distinguishing outcomes.
The unrealized human knowing supplies a contrast with the already doubled divine knowing of 68:7.
Making one thing into a state supplies the rejected act of treating unlike trajectories as equivalent.
Wholeness and freedom from defect supply one side of the demanded distinction.
Culpable offense supplies the acquired condition on the other side of the distinction.
Judgment between people supplies the challenged human sorting operation.
A written determination that imposes judgment supplies the demanded documentary warrant.
Speech without certainty supplies the rival claim whose authority is being exposed as empty.

structural_cues: The interrogative run in 68:35-41 repeatedly demands a basis for equating unlike groups and for issuing a competing judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-equation, judgment, a purported book, and unsupported claim; I infer a quasi-forensic challenge in which divine knowledge secures just classification. The live alternative is rhetorical shaming without a formal evidentiary model.

changed_reading.before: The verse states omniscience as a detached divine attribute.
changed_reading.after: The verse supplies the epistemic ground of just non-equation and invalidates classifications based on assertion, status, or imagined documents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call to bow occurs in two times: once when people are whole and able to respond, and later when they are called but cannot. Guidance consequently appears as timely, embodied responsiveness, while refused orientation can terminate in incapacity rather than merely in holding an incorrect proposition.

activation_trace.role: Calm and composed bearing lets guidance register as a bodily capacity maintained under demand.
Calling that inclines by speech supplies the directional summons offered at both times.
Bending the head and body supplies the concrete response the summons seeks.
Capacity to perform supplies the later missing ability rather than only a missing opinion.
Former wholeness and freedom from impairment establish that an earlier window for response was genuinely present.

structural_cues: 68:42-43 repeat the same summons across a changed modal condition: 'they cannot' now, although they were called while whole before.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated calling, bodily bowing, present inability, and former wholeness; I infer that refused responsiveness hardens into incapacity. The live alternative is that the later inability is imposed punishment rather than habituated formation.

changed_reading.before: The guided are people who possess correct cognition.
changed_reading.after: The guided can be read as people whose timely response has become a composed capacity, whereas deviation may become embodied inability when the call returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: A counter-route unfolds by walking and being taken degree after degree, specifically from where its travelers do not know, while extended time and a firm strategy keep it stable. The Lord's superior knowledge in 68:7 now includes trajectory beneath perceived position: apparent continuation can be concealed descent.

activation_trace.role: The traversed road anchors gradual taking as an alternative trajectory relative to the Lord's way.
Complete disclosure to the Lord covers a direction that remains undisclosed to those moving within it.
Walking and proceeding on a road supplies actual movement rather than a static sentence.
Taking degree by degree supplies the hidden incremental mechanism of the counter-route.
Their lack of disclosure creates the explicit epistemic inversion of the focus verse.
Extended time and respite provide enough duration for imperceptible directional change to accumulate.
Strategic contrivance supplies the hidden agency organizing the gradual movement.
Extended solidity makes the strategy durable enough to remain mistaken for stable footing.

structural_cues: The explicit contrast is between first-person gradual action and third-person non-knowledge in 68:44, followed by temporal extension in 68:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies road movement, degree-by-degree taking, non-knowledge, respite, strategy, and firmness; I infer that apparent progress can mask moral descent. The live alternative is simple deferred punishment without any subjective sense of progress.

changed_reading.before: A strayer knows or could readily see that he has left the way.
changed_reading.after: A trajectory can depart by stable, incremental steps while its traveler experiences no epistemic alarm; the Lord knows direction beneath apparent position.

context_deltas.mechanism: Grace catches a person before the counterfactual endpoint of being thrown into exposure while blameworthy; then his Lord selects, draws near, makes, and repairs him into the righteous. This is not merely reclassification after new evidence. Lordly action interrupts one trajectory and produces another.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion make divine knowledge compatible with active restoration rather than passive sorting.
Gentle enabling toward the right course supplies the trajectory produced by the rescue.
Catching up with and reaching someone supplies intervention before the threatened endpoint.
Beneficent good condition supplies the grace that performs the interception.
The Lord's repairing care identifies the rescuer as the same developmental knower named in the focus.
Throwing away supplies the counterfactual terminal motion that grace prevents.
Blame and fault supply the negative state attached to that unrealized endpoint.
Selection and drawing near supply a positive reversal from threatened rejection.
Causing a thing to become a state supplies transformation rather than mere relabeling.
Repair opposed to corruption names the newly produced company and condition.

structural_cues: The unrealized apodosis in 68:49 is followed by actual selection and making in 68:50, preserving both the danger and the changed outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interception by grace, a counterfactual rejected state, selection, making, and repair; I infer that the focus categories can describe phases within a divinely redirected history. The live alternative is an exceptional rescue that should not be generalized to every strayer.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge observes which fixed category a person already occupies.
changed_reading.after: The nurturing Lord knows a whole vulnerable history and can catch, select, and remake a person before a threatened endpoint, so classification does not exhaust divine agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: After hearing the reminder, hostile observers nearly use their gaze to dislodge the addressee from his standing. This gives deviation an interpersonal causal grammar: one agent can try to make another lose footing. The Lord's knowledge of who strayed therefore need not flatten pressure, inducement, resistance, and responsibility into one undifferentiated label.

activation_trace.role: Departure from course supplies the possible result of losing one's station under hostile force.
The traversable way supplies the surface on which footing and displacement matter.
Sliding from one's station on a surface where feet cannot hold supplies the attempted displacement.
Eyesight supplies the hostile instrument through which the displacement is imagined or attempted.
Auditory reception supplies the event that triggers the observers' hostile reaction.
The reminder supplies the orienting message whose hearing provokes the attempt to remove its bearer.

structural_cues: The causative form in 68:51 assigns an attempted maker of slippage, while the addressee remains the threatened object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile looking, hearing the reminder, and attempted loss of footing; I infer that 68:7's perfect 'strayed' can conceal unequal causal pressures unless the knower distinguishes them. The live alternative is an idiom of intense staring with no literal or moral causation.

changed_reading.before: Straying is wholly self-originated and the label alone captures responsibility.
changed_reading.after: Straying can be attempted upon someone through hostile pressure; perfect knowledge distinguishes the pressured, the inducer, the resistance, and the eventual trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory allows lostness as loss of retention, while the surah closes with a reminder that restores something after forgetting. The final reminder can therefore act as a repair mechanism for one live mode of deviation: orientation returns through recollection rather than through acquisition of an entirely new road.

activation_trace.role: Loss from memory supplies a cognitive mode of being lost while remaining anchored in the focus verb.
Gentle indication supplies the renewed orientation that remembered truth can enable.
Bringing something back after forgetting supplies the direct reversal of mnemonic lostness.
A reminder designed to make one remember supplies the textual instrument of restored orientation.

structural_cues: The final ayah identifies the discourse itself as a reminder and extends its address to all worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgetting within the focus root and recollection in the closing root; I infer a repair relation in which reminder restores orientation. The live alternative is that dalla here excludes mnemonic loss and refers only to moral departure.

changed_reading.before: Guidance requires entering a route one never possessed.
changed_reading.after: One mode of guidance is recovered memory: the reminder returns a lost orientation that had slipped from retention.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins social placation, a smooth road, and hostile slippage into one material model. It remains anchored in the focus road and deviation roots and in two branch-backed context images. Downstream prose should present it as a friction analogy, not as an etymological identity or a claim that all accommodation causes deviation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Sabil names a traversable surface and dalla names departure from its aim; together they permit a question about what lets a traveler keep footing.

activation_trace.role: The extended road supplies the material surface whose friction can preserve or lose direction.
Departure from aim supplies the directional consequence of losing traction.
A smooth road materializes accommodation as a course made easy but potentially low in resistance.
A slick place that will not hold a foot supplies the endpoint of the reduced-friction analogy.

changed_reading.before: Compromise in 68:9 and attempted slippage in 68:51 are unrelated warnings.
changed_reading.after: They can coexist as a material arc: a path polished by accommodation loses resistance, and hostile pressure then seeks to dislodge the traveler.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it renders guidance as posture and stability rather than chiefly cognition. It remains anchored in the focus h-d-y branch of composed bearing and is sharpened by wholeness, restraint, and attempted slipping in context. Downstream prose should retain it as an embodied resonance alongside directional guidance, not replace the ordinary guidance sense with deportment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The guided participle can activate h-d-y's calm, composed bearing while remaining attached to the focus word.

activation_trace.role: Calm stillness and good bearing supply an embodied register of guidance.
Wholeness and freedom from impairment supply the bodily capacity within which response can be practiced.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the stabilizing discipline of composed bearing.
Attempted loss of footing supplies the external stress against which stable bearing becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: The guided are identified only by correct destination or belief.
changed_reading.after: The guided may also be recognized by a trained bearing that remains whole, restrained, and upright when pressure tries to remove their footing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant r-b-w mapping for focus rabb. It remains structurally anchored in rabbuka and is independently reinforced by the dominant nurture branch and by later making into repair. Downstream prose should mark it as a form-distant developmental activation, not a lexical replacement of Rabb with growth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus r-b-b secondarily to r-b-w, whose nourishment and growing-up branch can shadow the Lord's relation to the two trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Nourishment and growing up supply the form-distant image of trajectories developing rather than arriving preclassified.
Gentle direction and enabling supply the positive development that cultivation seeks.
The dominant nurture and repair branch independently grounds the developmental mechanism in the context.
Making someone become a state supplies an explicit transformation rather than static classification.
Repair opposed to corruption names the cultivated outcome of that transformation.

changed_reading.before: The Lord merely identifies already finished moral types.
changed_reading.after: A secondary developmental resonance makes the Lord's knowing longitudinal: He knows what trajectories are being nourished, interrupted, and grown toward repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant reading because it uses the packet's non-dominant h-d-d mapping for focus h-d-y. It remains anchored by that explicit split mapping and by context branches of stepwise road movement and lost footing. Downstream prose should carry it only as a contrastive phonetic-mapping shadow, never as a lexical gloss of al-muhtadin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's secondary mapping of focus h-d-y includes collapse and a difficult descent, allowing the guided to cast a contrastive shadow of travelers preserved from structural or directional breakdown.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and collapse supply the negative structural shadow against which guidance can appear as preservation.
A difficult descent supplies the form-distant terrain on which orientation is tested.
Degree-by-degree taking supplies incremental movement toward a result the traveler does not perceive.
Loss of footing supplies the contextual event that can initiate descent or collapse.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is only positive indication toward a destination.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained split-root shadow, guidance also contrasts with incremental descent, loss of footing, and collapse of the support that lets a course continue.

strongest_changes: The garden sequence turns hidden withholding into spatial misrecognition and then moral recognition, showing that the Lord knows a trajectory before its travelers can read it.
The owners' redirected desire and the rescued companion of the fish keep straying and guidance from functioning only as permanent identities.
Stepwise taking from where people do not know makes apparent stability compatible with concealed directional descent.
The repeated call to prostration shifts guidance toward timely embodied responsiveness and exposes a later loss of capacity.
The attempted slippage of 68:51 preserves external pressure and causal agency inside any account of who strays.
The closing reminder activates mnemonic lostness as a repairable mode in which guidance can arrive as recollection.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled a'lam did not collapse into a generic omniscience formula. Its symmetry held together sovereign judgment, stage-by-stage care, waymark legibility, hidden intention, social causation, bodily capacity, and recoverable trajectories without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The garden owners display reorientation, but the packet does not explicitly certify their final guided status.
The later inability to bow may result from accumulated refusal, imposed judgment, or both.
The slippage language may be idiomatic hostile looking rather than a literal causal model of deviation.
The mnemonic, friction, growth, and h-d-d descent readings are branch-backed but deliberately form-distant and require the stated containment.
